findings: (1) Ownership holds. `git diff --name-only f44f962...HEAD` (merge-base f44f962, HEAD 7880d99, worktree clean) lists 30 files, all inside the owned set. No justfile, .gitignore, web/pnpm-workspace.yaml, CI, program/ or scripts/*.py edit; root-owned changes are text-only in docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261007-s3/bazel_graph-root-requests.json.

(2) No forbidden writes found. Lane logs went to gitignored artifacts/s2/bazel_graph/ (not artifacts/runs/*). program/tools.json, scripts/tool_api.py and just/workflow.just are untouched. No model download. The only live Bazel servers on the host belong to other repositories (greatfallstoolbus.org, scheduling-bridge); none for video-utils. Note that .bazelrc sets `build --disk_cache=~/.cache/bazel-video-utils`, a write outside the repo but not to a forbidden path.

(4) Owned module reproduced: `Ran 34 tests in 0.404s, OK (skipped=1)`, the skip being ShimSelfTest.test_marker_case_runs_only_under_the_shim. Counts match the claim (34 discovered, 33 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed).

(4) Merge-forward check: in a scratch copy of current main with the lane's 30 files overlaid (main now has 96 test modules), test_bazel_graph_s3 still passes 34/1 skip. A subset of existing modules that scan the tree (test_sprint1_audit, test_s2_tool_admission, test_report_bundle, test_holdout_release, test_corpus, test_tool_contracts) ran 155 tests OK. `cargo test --locked -j 1` passed there too (15 lib, 7 cli, 5 dsp with 1 ignored). The added BUILD.bazel files are not picked up by the suffix filters in native/au-spike/check.py:162 or packaging/build.py:124.

(4) Receipt inconsistency: bazel_graph-tests.json lists two skipped tests (including NegativeSelfChecks.test_constructs_outside_the_subset_raise_instead_of_being_skipped) for the native run, but the runner reports skipped=1 and that test runs `ok`. The receipt should be corrected; not merge-blocking.

(4) The lane did not run `just check`, `just test` (full suite), `just test-rust` or `pnpm build` in the worktree (tests.json `not_run_by_lane`), so the definition-of-done line 'do not break' those gates is only partly evidenced. My partial runs found no breakage; the full Python suite and pnpm build remain unrun by me as well.

(3) Claim classes are sound. The summary separates measured from not-run: 3 of 95 Python modules ran under Bazel, 178 targets were analysed only, and web was verified only in a scratch copy with `allowBuilds: {}`. registry_modules.json labels compliance as inference and dependency edges as unknown. No audio-accuracy, note-correctness or default/profile adoption claim appears anywhere in the lane.

(3) Contract deviation, disclosed by the lane: section 8 allowed one host Bazel attempt and the lane ran about 15 bounded invocations. The first attempt is recorded as `ran_failed` (exit 2, undeclared web/.npmrc, an authored defect since fixed). Root must decide whether the extra runs are accepted.

(3) Committed-tree limitation, disclosed by the lane: `bazel mod graph` exits 2 and `//web:build` exits 48 until root adds `allowBuilds: {}` to web/pnpm-workspace.yaml. Consequently `just bazel-graph` and the default `//...` of `just bazel-build` / `just bazel-test` fail as committed. Nothing imports just/bazel.just yet, so merging breaks no existing gate, but 'working Bzlmod graph' holds only for Rust and Python until root applies requests 1 and 2.

(3) The draft CI step `bazel test //tests:python_stdlib` has never been run (only 3 Python modules ran under Bazel). The test-classification lists are explicitly unvalidated by Bazel (tests/BUILD.bazel header). Keep the CI job `continue-on-error`, as drafted.

(5) Doctrine: no high-pass, notch or audio-processing default is introduced. Timeouts are bounded (tools/bazel/run.py default 1800 s with process-group kill, 60 s shutdown; .bazelrc `test_timeout=120,600,1800,3600`, `max_idle_secs=120`, `jobs=4`). No remote cache is configured and run.py refuses remote flags. Registry order in .bazelrc is tinyland at 8d3e540 then BCR, and MODULE.bazel.lock agrees (169 tinyland-registry entries, all 'not found', and 207 BCR entries).

(6) Arithmetic reproduced: workers 66 top-level + 1 frozen = 67 (`find scripts -name '*.py'` gives 67); tests 95 at lane HEAD; registry decisions 5 decided + 64 not evaluated = 69 = module_count and 69 keys in `modules`; 18 FFmpeg-tagged and 14 host-tool entries in tests/BUILD.bazel; 11 NegativeSelfChecks tests in the run output.

MODULE.bazel pins aspect_rules_js 3.5.1 and aspect_rules_ts 3.10.1, deliberately newer than the estate's 2.9.1 / 3.8.4 (reason given: pnpm 11 `allowBuilds`). The departure is documented in the research doc section 3; root should be aware of it.
